resources.string: Microphone held by the assistant. Tap to open.
SEVEN is listening for its name
Say \"Seven\" then your instruction. Microphone stays open.

SEVEN listens only while the orb is in Listening, or while the foreground service is holding the microphone for the wake word. Audio is processed on this device; only the transcript is sent to the selected model.
Microphone access is blocked for SEVEN. Open app settings, choose Permissions → Microphone, and allow it, then tap MIC again.
Used to resolve a name you say into a phone number. Contact data is never uploaded.
Needed to send a message on your behalf. Every outgoing message asks for confirmation first.
